200.description: The live authorization the checkout session already holds (no new authorization was created).

Idempotency-Replayed.description: "true" when the answer is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key; absent on the first execution.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number set at capture; null until then.

trackingNumbers.description: Tracking numbers of the group's packages; empty until captured.

expiresAt.description: Absent when the authorization has no expiry (DECLINED).

declineReason.description: The provider's decline code; present only on a DECLINED authorization.

201.description: The authorization this call created (AUTHORIZED or DECLINED).

Idempotency-Replayed.description: "true" when the answer is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key; absent on the first execution.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number set at capture; null until then.

trackingNumbers.description: Tracking numbers of the group's packages; empty until captured.

expiresAt.description: Absent when the authorization has no expiry (DECLINED).

declineReason.description: The provider's decline code; present only on a DECLINED authorization.

400.description: idempotency-key-required (no Idempotency-Key header), idempotency-key-invalid (not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters) or malformed-request.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example over-refund.

409.description: duplicate-authorization (ErrDuplicateAuthorization), concurrent-update or idempotency-key-reused (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example over-refund.

422.description: validation-failed, negative-amount or allocation-mismatch (ErrAllocationMismatch, also a groupNo that appears twice).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example over-refund.

500.description: internal-error (an unexpected failure; the detail never carries the internal message).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example over-refund.

503.description: payment-provider unreachable or timed out (payment-provider-unavailable). Nothing is stored; retry with the same Idempotency-Key, provider keys are deterministic.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example over-refund.
